description: Show/hide individual designs in the Helping Hands design viewer. Jake (voice): 'Can we have the option to show or hide a particular design in one thing? Like, I don't really care about Gen 1 or Gen 2 right now.' Ask: a per-design visibility toggle so Jake can hide designs (e.g. gripper Gen 1 and Gen 2) from the designs list/viewer and unhide them later; the choice persists. Make the action reachable by voice too.
